Package com.datalogic.itemtracking

Interface ItemTrackingManager.EventListener

Enclosing class:
ItemTrackingManager
public static interface ItemTrackingManager.EventListener
Listener interface for receiving item tracking events. Applications can register an implementation of this interface using the ItemTrackingManager.addEventListener(EventListener) method to receive notifications about item tracking events, such as item insertion or extraction. De-registration can be done using the ItemTrackingManager.removeEventListener(EventListener) method. Implementations of this interface must define the behavior for handling events through the onEvent(EventType, int, List) method.

  • Method Details

    • onEvent

      void onEvent(ItemTrackingManager.EventListener.EventType eventType, int numItems, List<String> itemIdentifiers)
      Callback method executed when an item tracking event is received. This method is invoked by the tracking system whenever an event occurs, providing details about the type of event and the number of items involved.
      Parameters:
      eventType - The type of event that occurred, represented as an ItemTrackingManager.EventListener.EventType. Possible values are:
      • ItemTrackingManager.EventListener.EventType.INSERTION: Indicates items added to the shopping cart.
      • ItemTrackingManager.EventListener.EventType.EXTRACTION: Indicates items removed from the shopping cart.
      numItems - The number of items involved in the event. For example:
      • For ItemTrackingManager.EventListener.EventType.INSERTION, this represents the number of items added.
      • For ItemTrackingManager.EventListener.EventType.EXTRACTION, this represents the number of items removed.
      itemIdentifiers - A list of item identifiers. Its size is equals or lower than the number of items involved in this event. When an item has not been identified, it will not be added to this list.
